candidates.snippet: CTP-ISW will continue to monitor the situation and provide updates as events warrant. Read CTP-ISW’s latest analysis about the situation in Yemen here: https://t.co/cXC4vwtaln (7/7)

The fighting near Ras al Ara could indicate that the Houthis intend to continue their advance along Yemen’s southern coast. The Houthis may also be trying to prevent Yemeni government forces from launching a counteroffensive to retake territory that the Houthis have seized along
The outlet noted that the Houthis have launched missiles near Ras al Ara in recent days to prevent Yemeni government forces from reorganizing and launching a counteroffensive. (5/7)
